context: Talking about a new advanced material
purpose: Discuss materials science; teach 物質/形成/プロセス/手法/用い/破壊/相互/生命

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この新素材、どんな物質でできてるんですか？
lines.en: What substance is this new material made of?
lines.style: curious student examining the sample, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 炭素を主成分に、特殊な構造を形成しています。
lines.en: It forms a special structure, mainly from carbon.
lines.style: researcher explaining the composition, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 製造のプロセスは複雑そうですね。
lines.style: student appreciating the difficulty, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、高温で圧縮する手法を用います。
lines.en: Yes, we use a high-temperature compression method.
lines.style: researcher detailing the technique, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 強度はどれくらいですか？
lines.style: student probing performance, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 破壊されにくく、軽いのが特徴です。
lines.en: It resists destruction and is light — that’s its hallmark.
lines.style: researcher highlighting the advantage, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 分子の相互作用がその秘密なんですね。
lines.en: Molecular interaction is the secret, then.
lines.style: student grasping the principle, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう。いつか生命科学にも応用できるでしょう。
lines.en: Right. Someday it may apply to life sciences too.
lines.style: researcher envisioning the future, tone holding steady through the whole line
